name: Sichuan Thrush
rangeDescription: Breeds south-central china (central sichuan); winter range poorly known, but reported from northern vietnam (tonkin)
description: Little-known thrush which breeds in the dense hilly and montane forests of China’s northern and central Sichuan province; favors dense understory and coniferous stands. Brown above with scaled white underparts.

name: Rennell Shrikebill
rangeDescription: Rennell (southeastern solomon islands)
description: A large orange-brown bird with a black mask and a long, slightly decurved grayish-blue bill. Note the pale tuft at the “armpit.” Found mainly in the dense, tangled understory of primary forest.

name: Streaked Bowerbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern papua new guinea (owen stanley mountains)
description: A fairly small bowerbird of foothill and lower montane forest. Dull brown color with some subtle streaking on the throat and breast.

name: Nilgiri Sholakili
rangeDescription: Peninsular india (nilgiri hills of mysore and western madras)
description: Dumpy little bird, slaty-blue with a tan belly. Highly restricted and scattered range in the Nilgiri Hills, where it is found at 900-2100 meters of elevation in sholas (patches of stunted montane forest separated by open grassy areas).

name: Sula Megapode
rangeDescription: Lowlands of banggai and sula islands (off eastern sulawesi)
description: A dumpy, partridge-like bird with an obvious crest and powerful legs and feet. Uniform reddish-brown with dull orange legs.

name: Magellanic Penguin
rangeDescription: Patagonian coasts, staten, falkland, and juan fernández islands
description: Fairly common to locally common; often seen in inshore waters and from ferries. Breeds around coasts of southern Chile, Argentina, and in the Falklands; nests in colonies in underground burrows.

name: Plains-wanderer
rangeDescription: Locally in sparse grassland of inland southeastern australia
description: Unique terrestrial bird, endemic to Australia, where found in sparse native grasslands in parts of central and southern Australia. Extremely secretive and elusive, this species is unlikely to be observed without deliberate search and professional help.

name: Yellow-footed Gull
rangeDescription: Islands in gulf of california; ranges north to salton sea
description: Large, dark-backed, and stout-billed gull. Adult has dark slaty gray back like Western Gull, but note the rich yellow legs.

name: Cream-eyed Bulbul
rangeDescription: Borneo (confirmed from sarawak, sabah, and northeastern kalimantan, but probably more widespread)
description: Dull dirt-brown bulbul with pale button eyes. Currently only known from northern Borneo, where it is the only plain brown bulbul with white eyes.

name: Guatemalan Flicker
rangeDescription: Highlands of southeastern mexico east of the isthmus of tehuantepec from western chiapas eastward to northwestern nicaragua
description: Large, brownish woodpecker with black barring on the back and black spots on the belly. Easily recognized in flight by its bright white rump.

name: Crow-billed Drongo
rangeDescription: Eastern himalayas to southern china; winters to southeastern asia and greater sundas
description: Large dark drongo of open forested environments. Glossy black with a characteristically forked tail.

name: Gray-tailed Piha
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of southern colombia, eastern ecuador, and eastern peru
description: Scarce denizen of cloud forest along the east slope of the Andes in Ecuador, Peru, and southern Colombia. Olive with a blotchy white eyering and gray belly and tail.

name: Sooty Myzomela
rangeDescription: Makira and santa ana (southeastern solomon islands)
description: Silky black with a slight bluish-green tinge to the wing and tail feathers when seen in direct sunlight. Juvenile has a distinctive fleshy yellow bill, tipped black.

name: Pied Thrush
rangeDescription: Himalayas of northern india from nepal to assam; winters to sri lanka
description: Slender, ground-dwelling thrush. Male is breathtakingly decked out in black and white.

name: Little Black Cormorant
rangeDescription: Australasian region to malay archipelago
description: Small all-black cormorant with green eyes. Often forms large flocks both in the air and while foraging on the water.

name: Rio Branco Antbird
rangeDescription: Far northern brazil (along rio branco) and adjacent guyana
description: A slender, long-tailed bird of dense gallery forests and river islands in northern Brazil and extreme southwestern Guyana. Male is mostly black with tail feathers tipped white and with white scalloping on wings.

name: Yellow-billed Giant-Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Fiji (taveuni and vanua levu)
description: A very large, robust honeyeater. Entirely drab grayish-olive, with yellowish wings and tail and a bright yellow bill and eye-ring.

name: Black-banded Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: North-central australia (western escarpment of arnhem land)
description: Very large black-and-white forest pigeon, found as singles or small groups in large fruiting trees beside sandstone escarpments in the Kakadu National Park region of the Northern Territory. Generally hard to find.

name: Gray-faced Tit-Babbler
rangeDescription: Forest of southern laos, central and southern vietnam, and cochinchina
description: Dull brown babbler with yellowish-tinged underparts, a faintly gray face, and a warmer orange-brown crown. Throat and chest are faintly streaked, but not as evident as that of the very similar Pin-striped Tit-Babbler, from which Gray-faced can also be distinguished by its grayer face and less contrast between the more warmly-colored crown and duller upperparts.

name: Sunda Coucal
rangeDescription: Lowlands of java
description: Uncommon and localized Javan endemic, restricted to coastal marshes, mangroves, estuaries, and adjacent scrubby and grassy growth. Black overall, with bright red eyes and patchy rufous-and-black wings.
